## Summary

Describe the focused outcome of this pull request.

## Why this is needed

Explain the FDE, operator, contributor, or maintainer problem being solved.

## Change type

- [ ] Skill behavior or routing
- [ ] Documentation or installation
- [ ] Synthetic example
- [ ] Validation or tooling
- [ ] Cloudflare application guidance
- [ ] UiPath integration guidance
- [ ] Security, privacy, accessibility, or governance

## Evidence and sources

List the evidence, synthetic fixture, or primary documentation supporting the change. Do not include customer-confidential material.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -B scripts/validate_repository.py`
- [ ] Relevant engagement validation passed
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a synthetic example or regression check
- [ ] Markdown links resolve
- [ ] Word handbook regenerated if its source documents changed
- [ ] DOCX render inspected, or the unavailable render limitation is stated

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No credentials, customer data, unnecessary personal data, or proprietary process details are included
- [ ] Evidence attribution and claim types remain intact
- [ ] Lifecycle gates and named approval requirements are not weakened
- [ ] External permissions are not expanded by model instructions
- [ ] Migration, compatibility, rollback, and known limitations are explained

## Reviewer notes

Call out the files, decisions, or risks that deserve the closest review.
